name: agent-relay
description: Delegate bounded tasks from Codex through OpenCode or the Codex CLI execution backend, using the shared durable job manager.

interface.longDescription: Launch, manage, and collect detached jobs from Codex through OpenCode subscription or direct API routes, or through the Codex CLI. The shared manager supports status, result, wait, cancellation, and exact-session continuation.
capabilities: OpenCode jobs through subscription and direct API routes
Codex CLI jobs with exact-session continuation
Job status, result, wait, cancellation, and collection
